paras: Lobulia brongersmai, also known as the Brongersma's lobulia, is a species of skink, a lizard in the family Scincidae. The species is endemic to the island of New Guinea.
The preferred natural habitat of L. brongersmai is forest, at altitudes of 1,000–1,500 m (3,300–4,900 ft).
The specific name, brongersmai, is in honor of Dutch herpetologist Leo Brongersma.
L. brongersmai may attain a snout-to-vent length (SVL) of 5.9 cm (2.3 in).
The mode of reproduction of L. brongersmai is unknown.
